description: MCP server exposing one tool per verification vendor. This server performs NO scoring or normalization -- it is a thin, auditable transport layer. Auth/secrets live only here, never in the orchestrator.

tools.name: giact_verify
tools.description: Calls LSEG GIACT PostInquiry (POST /api/v5/inquiries) for account/identity/OFAC verification. Minimum input: (routing_number + account_number) OR (first_name + last_name + (ssn OR dob)).

tools.name: ekata_identity_check
tools.description: Calls Ekata identity_check (GET /3.3/identity_check) for name/phone/address/email/IP cross-validation and risk scores. Minimum input: name + at least one of (phone, email, address).

tools.name: ews_check
tools.description: Calls Early Warning Services for account-abuse / fraud-history signals. Minimum input: (routing_number + account_number) OR ssn.

notes: min_input_rules is evaluated deterministically by the orchestrator wrapper (engine/orchestrator_stub.py: has_min_fields) -- it is NOT left to LLM judgment.
Adding a 4th vendor means adding one tool definition here plus one mapping block in engine/canonical_mapper.py. No changes to rules/ or the orchestrator loop are required.
